notes:
## Fixes

- **The Make contact sheets and Share a folder window is easier to use.**
  - It now has two columns: the scenes on the left, and the sheets and torrent choices on the right.
  - It opens at a sensible size, and every screen scrolls if you make the window smaller.
- **Grid and width are now buttons you click**, instead of drop-down lists.
- **The finished screen shows what to do next.**
  - A "Next" step names the folder to choose in your torrent program, so it shares the files instead of downloading them again.
  - A "Then" step says what to send your friends.
  - Open in my torrent program, Copy magnet link and Open the folder are at the bottom, and the last sheet made stays in view.
- **Folder names instead of long paths.** Hover over them to see the full path.
- **"All 3 found"** now says how many scenes can be ticked, and shows a dash when only some are ticked.
- **Clearer questions.** The question about sheets that already exist is clearer, and Esc closes the window.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
